patches.text: The effect edit screen no longer jumps back to the main screen after a few seconds. It stays until you press EXIT.

patches.name: Scale pads
patches.text: In chromatic mode with a scale chosen, all 16 pads play notes of the scale, from the bottom left upwards: about two octaves, starting an octave below the root. Stock firmware darkens the pads outside the scale instead. The VALUE knob moves the grid by a row (with SHIFT, by one step). The playable range is +/-24 semitones.

patches.name: Chromatic voices
patches.text: In chromatic mode, hold REMAIN and turn VALUE to choose LEGATO, MONO, POLY 2 to POLY 8 voices, or unlimited POLY. With a voice count, the oldest note stops when you play one more. The pitch/speed panel's PITCH and FINE now tune the chromatic notes.
patches.warning: On an SP-404MKII without this patch, editing VARI or the chromatic mode of a pad set to POLY 2-8 resets that pad's VARI and mode to their defaults.

patches.name: VARI Plus time stretch
patches.text: A fourth VARI option, Plus, next to Off, Backing and Ensemble (hold SHIFT on the pitch/speed panel). It stretches and pitch-shifts with fewer smeared attacks and less phasiness. It costs more CPU than the stock modes, so many voices at once can be too much. Changing VARI while a pad plays no longer restarts it.
patches.warning: Pads set to the new VARI value play like 'Backing' (with a longer splice) on an SP-404MKII without this patch.

patches.name: Guitar tuner
patches.text: Press BANK A and BANK B together on the main screen to open a tuner: it shows the nearest note and how many cents sharp or flat you are. It listens to the SP's output, input effects included, so keep other sounds quiet while tuning; EXT SOURCE is switched on so the input is heard. EXIT or the same two buttons take you back. Pressing VALUE steps through a few diagnostic screens and back.
